delivery_target: Any caller that passes a kheap-equality proof to valid_arch_tcb_pspaceI; the stronger form needs only the valid_arch_tcb hypothesis
new_lemma:
lemma valid_arch_tcb_pspaceI_no_kheap:
  "valid_arch_tcb t s \<Longrightarrow> valid_arch_tcb t s'"
  by (simp add: valid_arch_tcb_def)
rationale: valid_arch_tcb is defined as \<lambda>a. \<top> (L251), so valid_arch_tcb t s = True for every t and s. The premise valid_arch_tcb t s and the conclusion valid_arch_tcb t s' are both trivially True. The conjunct kheap s = kheap s' is therefore structurally irrelevant; simp add: valid_arch_tcb_def closes the stronger statement directly.
strengthening_claim: (valid_arch_tcb t s) ==> (valid_arch_tcb t s \<and> kheap s = kheap s')
